notes: Robinhood Chain, chain id 4663. SOVRN.ONE (nine ASCII characters, one full stop) / SVO has 18 decimals and a fixed 1,000,000,000 supply minted to its deployer. The pool is paired with IMD, an ERC-20 at 0x5F7Bb59365ce557C26dbcAa4EE9d39A4b95B7127 (18 decimals): the pool currencies are {IMD, SVO} ordered by address, so IMD is currency0 exactly when its address is lower than the token's. initialPrice is indicative only (sqrtPriceX96 for IMD as currency0 and a 3,000 IMD opening cap, i.e. about 333,333 SVO per IMD); the launch factory sets the real opening price, cap and order, and the hook accepts whatever it initializes. The pool LP fee is 12500 (1.25%), additional to hook fees; tick spacing is 60. SovrnHook takes manager, token and factory in the declared flat order, with no owner argument; its constructor reverts unless block.chainid is 4663 and IMD has code. Its five permissions encode 8396 (0x20cc); all others are false. Callbacks are PoolManager-only. Only the supplied factory may initialize its single pool through the manager; second initialization and wrong pool keys are rejected. The hook constructor deploys the immutable LifeForceVault, discoverable through vault(), with no separate manifest entry. Every hook fee is paid in IMD. Sells pay 3.5%. Buy fees decay linearly from 50% through 26.75% to 3.5% at elapsed 0/1800/3600 seconds after initialization. The base quote mechanism, four exact-input/output modes and partial-fill fee handling are retained. All hook fees go directly to the vault when the manager's IMD covers the fee; otherwise the hook records one ERC-6909 claim counter for currency id uint160(IMD). Anyone may redeemFees() after settlement to pay the entire counter to the vault. The vault holds IMD and derives its reserves from its IMD balance: buybackReserve gets floor(x * 3000 / 10000) and inferenceReserve the remainder (BUYBACK_BPS 3000, INFERENCE_BPS 7000), reserves never sum to more than the real balance, and sync() checkpoints newly arrived IMD. Only REFUEL_SAFE 0xEb57c52272B90F989C41B739e2ccc5f00bF7697C may withdrawInference(amount) or withdrawBuyback(amount), each within its matching reserve and only to itself. The vault never swaps. Anyone may send IMD to it or burn() its entire SVO balance to DEAD; zero balance reverts. There are no owners, setters, further minting, pause, blacklist or upgrade powers. IMD has its own owner and rules that this code does not control: if IMD refuses a transfer to the vault, direct fee takes revert. Use PrepareLaunch to mine the new initcode for flags 8396; it has no environment reads or broadcasts. The factory must deploy, initialize and seed liquidity atomically to protect the opening price. Hook fees apply only to poolKey(); other pools are unrestricted. Live Safe control (including its signing threshold) is unverified here.
